subject: Retainer offset proposal & rebate — Acme latency incident
messages:
From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@acme-corp.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Platform performance — request for retainer offset after latency spike

Hi Aditya,

We saw a sustained increase in p99 latency on text-generation endpoints during the week of Feb 22–28 that materially affected several customer-facing flows. Our platform team traced the impact to model autoscaling hot-path delays — roughly 20 minutes of elevated latency across multiple zones on Feb 24. That resulted in several degraded requests and at least two support escalations on our side.

Given Acme's 12-month retainer and the critical nature of this workload, our procurement lead is asking for a retainer offset (one month) or a consumption rebate for March to help absorb the unexpected support and mitigation costs. Can you outline what Redwood can offer? We need something we can present to the Acme finance team by Friday.

Thanks,
Susan Lee
Head of Platform Reliability
Acme Corp

Attachments: none
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Platform performance — request for retainer offset after latency spike

Hi Susan — I appreciate the heads-up and am very sorry for the disruption. We ran an incident review and I'm sharing a short summary and an initial offer we think balances customer impact with precedent.

What happened (short):
- Root cause: autoscaling delay tied to an edge kernel regression during a seq_len spike on Feb 24.
- Impact window: ~20 minutes of elevated p99 for targeted gen endpoints; no data exfiltration.
- Mitigation: rollout of hotfix + proactive scheduling to pin kernel variant for similar traffic patterns.

Proposed remedial package (initial):
- One month retainer offset (applied to next invoice) OR 15% consumption rebate for March, capped at $40k — customer choice.
- Incident summary PDF attached for your audit.

Next steps: If Acme prefers the retainer offset, we'll need executive approval for the accounting impact. Marissa (cc) will handle the paperwork and can loop in Karthik for sign-off. If you want the rebate option, we'll provide a proposed calculation spreadsheet.

Again, apologies — we want to make this right and keep Acme running smoothly.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident-summary-20260222-20260228.pdf (PDF, 3pg)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Retainer offset proposal & rebate — Acme latency incident

Team — looping in Karthik and Jonas for exec path. Aditya already presented the two options to Acme (one-month retainer offset OR 15% rebate capped at $40k). Finance impact estimates attached. Summary below:

Impact summary (from our quick calc):
- Average monthly retainer revenue from Acme: $200k
- One-month offset = ~ $200k recognized revenue deferred (accounting: retainer credit)
- 15% rebate estimate for March usage = ~$30k based on current run-rate

Ask: Karthik — can we get conditional sign-off for the one-month offset if ops validates the incident mitigations and legal signs off on a short amendment? If not, can you approve the rebate option (15% up to $40k) so we can close with Acme this week?

Attachment: proposed-offset-calculation.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success (Sales Escalations)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retainer offset proposal & rebate — Acme latency incident

Marissa / Aditya — reviewed numbers and ops summary. I approve a conditional remediation offer to Acme with these constraints:

Approved offer (exec):
- Primary: One-month retainer offset applied to the next billing cycle, conditional on Ops confirming the hotfix verification and no recurring regressions in the 14-day post-fix window.
- Fallback: If Finance/legal prefer simpler accounting, approve 15% consumption rebate for March capped at $40k (whichever Acme chooses).

Conditions and controls:
- Offer must include a short remediation commitment: ops runbook update + a follow-up runbook review meeting with Acme within 10 business days.
- Legal to prepare a one-paragraph amendment; customer must sign via DocuSign.
- Any offsets > $100k require CFO visibility — this one is within tolerance but flag to finance.

Jonas, please capture this as an approved concession in the customer ledger and flag for quota/promo reporting. Marissa, proceed with the customer communication per Aditya's draft and attach the amendment link.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Remediation offer and DocuSign for retainer offset — Acme

Hi Susan — thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our internal approvals, Redwood can offer Acme the remediation package below: please confirm which option you prefer and sign the short amendment so we can apply it to the next invoice.

Offer (choose one):
1) One-month retainer offset (applied to next billing cycle) — conditional on ops verification of the fix within 14 days and the runbook review meeting.
2) 15% consumption rebate for March, capped at $40,000.

We have prepared a one-sentence amendment and DocuSign link (attached). If you confirm, we'll execute and the credit will appear on the next statement.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-52319

Appreciate your partnership and patience here.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: docusign-retainer-offset-Acme.pdf (DocuSign packet)
